tickets.title: Machine and MachinePanel base blocks, tile entities, and rotation
tickets.description: Implements foundational machine block infrastructure: BlockMachine (meta 0..15), BlockMachinePanel (meta 0..4), 6-direction rotation handling (IRotatable), active and powered state flags, and packet synchronization. Base tile entity abstractions TileMachine and TileMachinePanel with IFrameSupport and Redstone/Tube connection interfaces. Done: contract-check clean for machine block registration, placement, and 6-direction rotation.

tickets.title: Support frames, moving frame placeholders, and BFS structural movement
tickets.description: Implements support frames (rpframe, rptframe, rprtframe with tube and redstone conduit pass-through), side stickiness masking (covers and screwdriver toggle), moving frame entity placeholder (TileFrameMoving), entity pushing along translation axis, and atomic block/NBT transfer upon drop. Done: contract-check clean for frame, frame_tube, and frame_redstone_tube; level 1, 3, and 5 scenarios pass.

tickets.title: Deployer machine: 9-slot inventory, fake player right-click simulation, GUI
tickets.description: Implements Deployer (BlockMachine meta 0): 9-slot inventory, ContainerDeploy/GuiDeploy, and redstone-triggered right-click block placement and item use via Horizon fake player entity (supporting block placement, buckets, shears, bonemeal, weapons). Done: contract-check clean for deployer; level 1, 3, 4, 5 scenarios pass.

tickets.title: Block breaker: pulse harvesting, drop buffer, rear tube ejection
tickets.description: Implements Block Breaker (BlockMachine meta 1): harvests facing block on redstone pulse (respecting hardness >= 0, leaving unbreakable blocks intact), collects drops into internal TubeBuffer, and ejects collected items into connected rear pneumatic tubes or inventories. Done: contract-check clean for block_breaker; level 1, 3, 4, 5 scenarios pass.

tickets.title: Filter machine: 9 ghost filter slots, dye color tagging, extraction
tickets.description: Implements Filter (BlockMachine meta 3): 9-slot ghost item template, 16-color dye tagging button and cycling in GuiFilter, single-stack extraction on redstone pulse from adjacent inventory matching filter, and tag coloring on exported tube payloads. Done: contract-check clean for filter; level 1, 3, 4, 5, 6 scenarios pass.

tickets.title: Item detector: in-line tube detection, filter matching, pulse emission
tickets.description: Implements Item Detector (BlockMachine meta 4): in-line tube conduit block with 9-slot filter template, pulse emission when passing items match filter (or any item if empty), and mode selection (pulse on entry / exit). Done: contract-check clean for item_detector; level 1, 3, 4, 5 scenarios pass.

tickets.title: Assembler: 16-channel bundled cable deployer, 18-slot storage, GUI
tickets.description: Implements Assembler (BlockMachine meta 13): 16 template selector slots (0..15), 18 internal inventory slots (16..33), 16-channel Bundled Cable input mapping, and selective item deployment per active channel. ContainerAssemble and GuiAssemble with mode and skip slot toggles. Done: contract-check clean for assembler; level 1, 3, 4, 5, 6 scenarios pass.

tickets.title: Ejector machine: 9-slot buffer, pulse extraction and tube injection
tickets.description: Implements Ejector (BlockMachine meta 14): 9-slot internal inventory (TileEjectBase), single-item extraction from adjacent inventories into tube on redstone pulse, and tube backpressure buffering. ContainerEject and GuiEject. Done: contract-check clean for ejector; level 1, 3, 4, 5, 6 scenarios pass.

tickets.title: Igniter machine: redstone fire ignition and extinguishing
tickets.description: Implements Igniter (BlockMachine meta 12): creates fire on adjacent target face when powered by redstone, and extinguishes fire / removes netherrack flame when unpowered. Done: contract-check clean for igniter; level 1, 3, 4 scenarios pass.

tickets.title: Buffer chest: 20-slot storage, multi-faced partitioned sided inventory
tickets.description: Implements Buffer Chest (BlockAppliance meta 2): 20 inventory slots (ContainerBufferChest), 5-way partitioned sided access (4 dedicated slots per side/top/bottom face; back face connects to all 20 slots), and IRotatable placement. Done: contract-check clean for buffer_chest; level 1, 3, 5, 6 scenarios pass.

tickets.title: Blulectric furnace: 2x speed Blutricity smelting and sided access
tickets.description: Implements Blulectric Furnace (BlockAppliance meta 1): input slot 0, output slot 1, Blutricity endpoint connection (requires >= 60V, consumes 1,000 W-t/tick), 100-tick cook time (2x vanilla furnace speed), dynamic furnace glow lighting, and sided access (top: input, sides/bottom: output). Done: contract-check clean for blulectric_furnace; level 1, 3, 5, 6 scenarios pass.

tickets.title: Blulectric alloy furnace: fuel-less 3x3 alloy smelting powered by Blutricity
tickets.description: Implements Blulectric Alloy Furnace (BlockAppliance meta 4): 3x3 input matrix (slots 0..8) and output slot 9, fuel-less smelting using Blutricity (>= 60V, 1,000 W-t/tick, 100 ticks per cook), ContainerBlueAlloyFurnace and GuiBlueAlloyFurnace with charge and flow indicators. Done: contract-check clean for blulectric_alloy_furnace; level 1, 3, 5, 6 scenarios pass.

tickets.title: Battery box storage machine and rechargeable BT battery item
tickets.description: Implements Battery Box (BlockMachine meta 6): 6,000 storage units capacity, automatic charging when V > 90V, discharging when V < 80V (inhibited by redstone signal), 2 battery slots for charging/discharging BT Battery items at 25 units/tick. Done: contract-check clean for battery_box; level 1, 3, 5 scenarios pass.

tickets.title: Voltmeter diagnostic tool and Sonic Screwdriver chargeable multi-tool
tickets.description: Implements Voltmeter (displays voltage, current, and wattage in chat when right-clicking any Blutricity conductor or machine) and Sonic Screwdriver (rechargeable screwdriver with entity disorient / creeper defuse capabilities, consuming charge from internal battery). Done: contract-check clean for voltmeter and sonic_screwdriver; level 2 scenarios pass.

tickets.title: Magtubes: 16 blocks/tick magnetic transit, accelerator panel machine
tickets.description: Implements Magtube microblock conduit (BlockMicro damage 2816) with 16 blocks/tick travel speed, and Accelerator panel (BlockMachinePanel meta 2) requiring Blutricity (>= 60V, draws 100 W-t/item) to accelerate pneumatic payloads into magnetic capsules. Done: contract-check clean for magtube and accelerator; level 1, 3, 4 scenarios pass.

tickets.title: Grate machine panel: suction intake, pressurized dispersal, BFS fluid pathfinding
tickets.description: Implements Grate panel (BlockMachinePanel meta 3): connects to fluid pipe network, performs BFS fluid search to suck source liquid blocks under suction into attached pipe network or pour liquid into world under positive pressure. Done: contract-check clean for grate; level 1, 3, 4 scenarios pass.

tickets.title: Sorting machine: 40-slot 8-channel routing GUI and container
tickets.description: Implements ContainerSorter (40 slots in 8 columns of 5) and GuiSorter with 8 column color cycle buttons, 6 routing mode toggles (Any, Sequential, Full Stack, All, Even Distribution, Random), and Blutricity auto-pulling toggle. Done: container slot layout, GUI event packets, and color button states match original.

tickets.title: Retriever and regulator 9-slot and 27-slot logistics GUIs and containers
tickets.description: Implements ContainerRetriever / GuiRetriever (9 ghost filter slots, dye color selector, Blutricity power gauge) and ContainerRegulator / GuiRegulator (27 slots: 9 target stock template, 9 buffer, 9 excess export filter, mode button). Done: container slot layouts and GUI event packets match original.
